description: This PHP source file manages the local IP configuration interface for a network gateway. It includes server-side PHP code for retrieving device settings and generating HTML form elements, as well as embedded JavaScript for client-side validation, dynamic UI interactions, and AJAX requests to apply configuration changes.

methods.name: setIPconfiguration
methods.description: Sends the provided IP configuration JSON to the server via AJAX to update the device's IP settings.

methods.name: setIPv6configuration
methods.description: Sends the provided IPv6 configuration JSON to the server via AJAX to update IPv6 settings.

methods.name: calcuate_lease_time
methods.description: Calculates DHCP lease time in seconds based on the numeric value and the time unit (seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, forever).

methods.name: display_time_format
methods.description: Converts a DHCP lease time in seconds into a human-readable format and sets the corresponding form fields.

methods.name: display_time_format_V6
methods.description: Converts a DHCPv6 lease time in seconds into a human-readable format and sets the corresponding form fields.

methods.name: populateIPv6Addr
methods.description: Parses an IPv6 address string into an array of its segments for UI display.

methods.name: updateIPv6
methods.description: Updates the IPv6-related form fields and controls based on the current state, including enabling/disabling inputs according to the IPv6 mode.

methods.name: stateful_check
methods.description: Adjusts the ULA address input visibility and state depending on whether IPv6 is in Stateless or Stateful mode.

methods.name: validate_v4addr_pool
methods.description: Validates that the DHCP IP address pool start address is less than the end address.

methods.name: validate_v6addr_pool
methods.description: Validates that the DHCPv6 begin address is less than or equal to the end address.
